packageRules.description: Third-party GitHub Actions updates are grouped into one PR, pinned to commit digests, and wait three days after release; then Renovate automerges them once the required checks pass. The hive also merges mergeraptor[bot] PRs once the required checks pass, because it is a trusted bot.
First-party projectbluefin/** actions open at any time and Renovate automerges them as soon as the required checks pass. The hive also merges mergeraptor[bot] PRs once the required checks pass.

Keep first-party projectbluefin/** actions on the managed @v1 tag that AGENTS.md and .github/zizmor.yml require. This rule must not carry matchUpdateTypes: Renovate decides on digest pinning during lookup, before an update has a type, and skips any rule with matchUpdateTypes at that stage. It overrides the inherited config:best-practices helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests rule that produced #840.

Go module and Go toolchain non-major updates are grouped into one PR, tidied with go mod tidy, and wait three days after release; then Renovate automerges them once the required checks pass. The hive also merges mergeraptor[bot] PRs once the required checks pass, because it is a trusted bot.
Renovate never automerges GitHub Actions or Go module majors. The hive's trusted-bot merge policy is independent of this setting: it still merges mergeraptor[bot] PRs once the required checks pass.

The live Docker workflow must stay on ubuntu-24.04: internal/installcheck/workflows_test.go requires that exact runner (the Ubuntu kernel/module environment it tests). Renovate still updates runners in every other workflow.

release.yml are human-merge paths in the hive. Give their updates their own branches, so a pin-only update to them is a PR of its own that the hive's pin-only exception can merge, instead of being held with other workflows. Renovate doesn't merge these updates itself, because its own merge would skip the hive's hold on these files. The hive merges a pin-only update, and anything else, a major included, waits for a person.
